cards.front: Él se enteró de lo que había pasado.
cards.back: He found out what had happened.

cards.front: Él no se enteró de lo que había pasado hasta que ya era demasiado tarde.
cards.back: He didn't find out what had happened until it was far too late.

cards.front: Paddy no se enteró de lo que le había pasado a su hermana hasta que ya era demasiado tarde.
cards.back: Paddy didn't find out what had happened to his sister until it was far too late.

cards.front: Para cuando me enteré de lo que había pasado, ya era demasiado tarde.
cards.back: By the time I learned about what had happened, it was way too late.

cards.front: Para cuando Sandra se enteró de lo que había pasado, ya era demasiado tarde.
cards.back: By the time Sandra learned about what had happened, it was way too late.

cards.front: Ya era demasiado tarde para cuando su marido se enteró de lo que había pasado.
cards.back: It was way too late by the time her husband learnt about what had happened.

cards.front: No me enteré de lo que estaba pasando hasta que estuvo todo zanjado.
cards.back: I didn't hear about what was happening until it was done and dusted.

cards.front: Ellos no se enteraron de lo que estaba pasando hasta que estuvo todo zanjado.
cards.back: They didn't hear about what was happening until it was all done and dusted.

cards.front: Mi novio se enteró de lo que estaba pasando, pero para entonces ya estaba todo zanjado.
cards.back: My boyfriend heard about what was happening, but by then it was all done and dusted.

cards.front: Él se enteró de lo que estaba pasando.
cards.back: He got wind of what was happening.

cards.front: Ellos se enteraron de lo que había pasado, pero para entonces, todo había acabado.
cards.back: They got wind of what had happened, but by then it was all over.

cards.front: Mi madre se enteró de lo que había pasado, pero para entonces todo había acabado.
cards.back: My mother got wind of what had happened but by then it was all over.

cards.front: Me di cuenta de lo que había pasado, pero para entonces estaba todo zanjado.
cards.back: I caught on to what had happened, but by then it was all done and dusted.

cards.front: Su familia no se dio cuenta de lo que había pasado hasta que ya era demasiado tarde.
cards.back: His family didn't catch on to what had happened until it was far too late.

cards.front: Me di cuenta de lo que había pasado, pero Carla no se enteró hasta que todo se había acabado, ¡gracias a Dios!
cards.back: I caught on to what had happened, but Carla didn't get wind of it until it was all over, thank God!

cards.front: ¿Quién es ese tío de allí con pinta asquerosa? Da la casualidad de que es mi marido.
cards.back: Who's that creepy-looking guy over there? He happens to be my husband.

cards.front: ¡Vaya! ¡Es guapísima! Da la casualidad de que es mi madre.
cards.back: Whoa! She's gorgeous! She happens to be my mother.

cards.front: ¿Has visto ese coche rosa ridículo en el camino de entrada? Da la casualidad de que es mi coche.
cards.back: Did you see that ridiculous pink car in the driveway? That happens to be my car.

cards.front: La gente que escucha a Kenny Cohen es aburridísima. Resulta que yo tengo todos sus álbumes.
cards.back: People who listen to Kenny Cohen are really tedious. I happen to have all his albums.

cards.front: ¡Los aros de oro gigantes son muy horteras! Resulta que yo tengo varios pares.
cards.back: Gigantic gold hoop earrings are so tacky! I happen to have several pairs.

cards.front: Habría que ser bastante tonto para invertir en cosechas en estos momentos. Resulta que yo lo tengo todo en cosechas.
cards.back: You'd have to be pretty dumb to invest in crops at the moment. I happen to have everything in crops.

cards.front: ¡Tu colega Jane Womak es terrible! Pues resulta que a mí me parece encantadora.
cards.back: Your colleague Jane Womak is awful! Well, I happen to think she's lovely.

cards.front: Ese hombre de allí tiene una pinta rarísima. Da la casualidad de que a mí me parece muy guapo. Es mi novio.
cards.back: That man over there is really weird-looking. Well, I happen to think he's very handsome. He's my boyfriend.

cards.front: El vestido de esa mujer es muy hortera. ¿Tú crees? Pues resulta que a mí me parece que tiene mucha clase.
cards.back: That woman's dress is so tacky. Do you think so? Well, I happen to think it's very classy.

cards.front: ¡Los aros gigantes de plata son muy horteras! ¡Resulta que yo opino otra cosa!
cards.back: Gigantic silver loop earrings are so tacky! I happen to think otherwise!

cards.front: Invertir en cosechas en estos momentos es una idea bastante tonta. ¡Pues resulta que yo opino otra cosa!
cards.back: Investing in crops at the moment is a pretty dumb idea. Well, I happen to think otherwise!

cards.front: Esta música es tan aburrida. Pues resulta que yo opino otra cosa.
cards.back: This music is so tedious. Well, I happen to think otherwise.

cards.front: ¡Esa empresa es un desastre! Da la casualidad de que yo trabajo allí.
cards.back: That company is a mess! That's where I work, as it happens.

cards.front: Esta obra de teatro es una basura. Resulta que la escribí yo.
cards.back: This play is rubbish, isn't it? As it happens, I wrote it.

cards.front: Me he enterado de que el director está liado con la protagonista. ¡Da la casualidad de que el director es mi prometido!
cards.back: I heard the director's been having an affair with the lead actress. The director is my fiancé, as it happens!

cards.front: No tendrás un cigarrillo, ¿no?
cards.back: You don't happen to have a cigarette, do you?

cards.front: No tendrá ella un hermano que se llama Andy, ¿no?
cards.back: She doesn't happen to have a brother called Andy, does she?

cards.front: No tendrás una grapadora por casualidad, ¿no?
cards.back: You don't happen to have a stapler, do you?

cards.front: Tú no te encontrarías por casualidad con Kevin en Bristol, ¿no?
cards.back: You didn't happen to bump into Kevin in Bristol, did you?

cards.front: Tú no te encontrarías por casualidad con, cómo se llamaba... Jimmy, en el partido, ¿no?
cards.back: You didn't happen to bump into what's-his-name, Jimmy, at the match, did you?

cards.front: Shane no se encontraría por casualidad con, cómo se llamaba... Martha, ¿no?
cards.back: Shane didn't happen to bump into what's-her-name, Martha, did he?

cards.front: Te encontraste con Jeremy en la conferencia por casualidad, ¿no?
cards.back: You happened to run into Jeremy at the conference, didn't you?

cards.front: Shelley se encontró con su ex prometido en el gimnasio por casualidad, ¿no?
cards.back: Shelley happened to run into her ex-fiancé at the gym, didn't she?

cards.front: Miles se encontró por casualidad con esa mujer tan aburrida, Rose, en el baile, ¿no?
cards.back: Miles happened to run into that tedious woman, Rose, at the ball, didn't he?

cards.front: No irás abajo, ¿no? Si es que sí, ¿me podrías traer una taza de té, por favor?
cards.back: You wouldn't happen to be going downstairs, would you? If so, could you bring me up a cup of tea, please?

cards.front: No irás al supermercado, ¿no? Si es que sí, ¿me podrías traer algo de queso, por favor?
cards.back: You wouldn't happen to be going to the supermarket, would you? If so, could you get me some cheese, please?

cards.front: No irás a París otra vez este año, ¿no? Si es que sí, ¿me podrías traer una boina, por favor?
cards.back: You wouldn't happen to be going to Paris again this year, would you? If so, could you bring me back a beret, please?

cards.front: No te habrás encontrado con Phil Kinnot por casualidad, ¿no?
cards.back: You wouldn't happen to have run into Phil Kinnot, would you?

cards.front: No te habrás encontrado con Trevor hace poco por casualidad, ¿no?
cards.back: You wouldn't happen to have bumped into Trevor recently, would you?

cards.front: No habrás comido en Dom's hace poco, ¿no?
cards.back: You wouldn't happen to have had lunch in Dom's recently, would you?

cards.front: ¿Y la lámpara que tenías al lado de la mecedora?
cards.back: What happened to the lamp you had next to the rocking chair?

cards.front: ¿Y mis cigarrillos?
cards.back: What happened to my cigarettes?

cards.front: ¿Y la librería de la esquina?
cards.back: What happened to the bookshop on the corner?

cards.front: ¿Qué pasó con tus grandes planes para el verano?
cards.back: What ever happened to your big plans for the summer?

cards.front: ¿Qué pasó con esas clases de yoga en el parque?
cards.back: What ever happened to those yoga classes in the park?

cards.front: ¿Qué pasó con esa idea que tenías para la boda?
cards.back: What ever happened to that idea you had for the wedding?

cards.front: ¿Qué pasó con hacerte abogado para defender los derechos humanos? ¡Te gustaba tanto eso!
cards.back: What ever happened to becoming a human rights lawyer? You were so into that!

cards.front: ¿Qué pasó con conseguir tu título de Astronomía? ¡Te gustaba tanto eso!
cards.back: What ever happened to getting your degree in astronomy? You were so into that!

cards.front: ¿Qué pasó con montar tu propio negocio y ser tu propio jefe? ¡Te gustaba tanto eso!
cards.back: What ever happened to setting up your own business and working for yourself? You were so into that!

cards.front: ¿Qué pasó con aquel chico tan majo con el que salías?
cards.back: What ever happened to that nice guy you were seeing?

cards.front: ¿Qué pasó con la chica que trabajaba en la librería que hay a la vuelta de la esquina? Cómo se llamaba... Kim.
cards.back: What ever happened to the girl who worked in the bookshop around the corner? What's-her-name, Kim?

cards.front: ¿Qué pasó con, cómo se llamaba... Mark?
cards.back: What ever happened to what's-his-name, Mark?

cards.front: ¿Qué pasó con ese tipo que me presentaste en la fiesta de, cómo se llama... Eric? ¿Sabes, el que no podía ni hilar una frase?
cards.back: What ever happened to that guy you introduced me to at what's-his-name, Eric's party? You know the one that couldn't even string a sentence together?

cards.front: ¿Qué pasó con esa chica que trabajaba en la librería? ¿Sabes, la de la esquina donde todos los estudiantes pasan el rato?
cards.back: What ever happened to that girl who worked in the bookshop? You know, the one on the corner where all the students hang out.

cards.front: ¿Qué pasó con, cómo se llama... Mark, el que me presentaste, que montó su propio pequeño negocio el año pasado?
cards.back: What ever happened to what's-his-name, Mark, the one you introduced me to that set up his own little business last year?

cards.front: El incidente ocurrió fuera del supermercado en una bocacalle de la Quinta Avenida.
cards.back: The incident occurred outside a grocery store just off Fifth Avenue.

cards.front: Tenemos que impedir que ocurran cosas así en el futuro.
cards.back: We have to stop things like that from occurring in the future.

cards.front: Por mucho que lo intentaron, no pudieron impedir que ocurriese.
cards.back: Try as they might, they couldn't stop it from occurring.

cards.front: Algo está pasando fuera de la lavandería en una bocacalle de la calle principal.
cards.back: Something's going on outside the launderette just off the main street.

cards.front: ¿Habrías ido al evento si hubieras sabido lo que estaba pasando?
cards.back: Would you have gone to the event if you'd known what was going on?

cards.front: Por mucho que lo intentaron, no pudieron enterarse de lo que estaba pasando.
cards.back: Try as they might, they couldn't find out what was going on.

cards.front: Tuvo lugar una noche lúgubre en Salem.
cards.back: It took place on a dark, dreary night in Salem.

cards.front: Tuvo lugar una mañana helada en Vermont.
cards.back: It took place on a cold, frosty morning in Vermont.

cards.front: Habría tenido lugar ayer si no hubiera hecho un día con tanto vendaval.
cards.back: It would have taken place yesterday, if it hadn't been such a blustery day.

cards.front: La idea originalmente surgió como respuesta a un hueco en el mercado.
cards.back: The idea originally came about in response to a gap in the market.

cards.front: El proyecto no habría surgido si no hubiera habido un hueco obvio en el mercado.
cards.back: The project wouldn't have come about if there hadn't been an obvious gap in the market.

cards.front: Por mucho que lo intentó, no podía entender cómo había surgido el nuevo proyecto.
cards.back: Try as he might, he couldn't understand how the project had come about.

cards.front: El proyecto no habría surgido si no hubiéramos hablado de las ventas del año pasado.
cards.back: The project wouldn't have cropped up if we hadn't discussed last year's sales.

cards.front: La idea originalmente surgió en un seminario una mañana fría con vendaval en Vermont.
cards.back: The idea originally cropped up in a seminar on a cold, blustery morning in Vermont.

cards.front: Por mucho que lo intentamos, no podemos impedir que salga esta cuestión.
cards.back: Try as we might, we just can't stop this question from cropping up.

cards.front: No se me ocurrió la respuesta hasta el último momento.
cards.back: The answer didn't occur to me until the eleventh hour.

cards.front: No se me suele ocurrir hasta el último momento.
cards.back: It doesn't usually occur to me until the eleventh hour.

cards.front: No se me ocurrió la solución hasta que fue demasiado tarde.
cards.back: The solution didn't occur to me until it was far too late.

cards.front: ¿Te has parado a pensar en que a lo mejor deberías darle un respiro a él?
cards.back: Has it occurred to you that maybe you should give him a break?

cards.front: ¿Te has parado a pensar en que puede que necesites tomarte un descanso?
cards.back: Has it occurred to you that maybe you need to take a break?

cards.front: ¿Te has parado a pensar en que a lo mejor no es su culpa?
cards.back: Has it occurred to you that maybe it isn't her fault?

cards.front: No se le ocurrió a él mirar en el cajón de abajo hasta el último momento.
cards.back: It didn't occur to him to check the bottom drawer until the eleventh hour.

cards.front: No se les ocurrió ver qué decía su jefe primero.
cards.back: It didn't occur to them to check with their boss first.

cards.front: A nadie se le ocurrió preguntarle a él si se había mirado en los bolsillos.
cards.back: It didn't occur to anyone to ask him if he'd checked his pockets.

cards.front: Es una pregunta bastante obvia, ¡pero no se le ha ocurrido! Es un poco corto.
cards.back: It's a really obvious question but it hasn't occurred to him! He's a bit dim.

cards.front: Tiene la respuesta delante de las narices, pero no se le ha ocurrido. Es bastante corto.
cards.back: The answer is staring him in the face but it hasn't occurred to him. He's quite dim.

cards.front: Tiene la solución delante de las narices, pero todavía no se le ha ocurrido. Es muy, pero que muy corta.
cards.back: The solution is staring her in the face but it hasn't occurred to her yet. She's seriously dim.

cards.front: A Linda se le ocurrió una idea que jamás se me habría ocurrido a mí. ¡Es tan lista!
cards.back: Linda came up with an idea that would never have occurred to me. She's so bright!

cards.front: Se le ocurrió una solución brillante que jamás se nos habría ocurrido a nosotros. ¡Es tan espabilada!
cards.back: She came up with a brilliant solution that would never have occurred to us. She's so switched-on!

cards.front: A ella se le ocurrió una respuesta que jamás se me habría ocurrido a mí. ¡Yo no soy muy espabilada!
cards.back: She came up with an answer that would never have occurred to me. I'm not very switched-on!
